bilateral_support_rule: For each candidate edge (u,v), u must have another dense neighbor whose Arachne dominant joint equals u's dominant joint, and v must independently have another dense neighbor whose dominant joint equals v's dominant joint.
postfilter: Apply the already-preregistered graph 2-core after bilateral support.
rationale: A coherent mechanical seam should separate two locally supported skin regimes; an isolated erroneous weight row tends to create unsupported star-like discontinuities.
teacher_policy: Teacher source topology is evaluation-only after candidate, bilateral support, and 2-core are frozen.
